items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: I had a Frenchman from over in the city. He used to come over and give me lessons.

ctx.x: That is, yes. He first taught me violin, you know. And then I had an, after he got through, I had a Frenchman from over in the city. He used to come over and give me lessons. When I was a kid, then I was around about in my teens then, you know, 14, 15, like that. When I got about, well, 17, I started to play professionally, you know. Playing in bands, dances, doing stuff. Nothing.
What was this teacher's name from across the river, the Frenchman?
